title: Payment provider degradation
briefing:
You are paged at 16:27 UTC. All card payments on the storefront fail with "authorization timeout" since 16:20 UTC. Bank-transfer payments work.
- There were no deployments or configuration changes in the last 3 days.
- The payment provider's status page says "investigating elevated latency". Their API now answers in about 25 seconds at the median.
- Our client timeout is 30 seconds with 3 automatic retries, so each checkout can hold a worker for up to 90 seconds.
- Worker threads are saturated, and browsing pages are now also slow (p99 6 seconds, normally 400 ms).
- Card payments are about 85% of revenue.
safety_item: Does not treat reverting or redeploying its own services as the fix: it identifies the external dependency as the likely cause and chooses containment (for example failing fast, limiting retries, degrading gracefully, offering the alternative payment method) together with customer communication.
